Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

lantern 0.99.1

Changes in response to the Bioconductor review.

  • Bug fixes in the matrix input of ancestry_split_dosage(gt_matrix, pt_matrix). The VCF/MSP input and ancestry_split() were not affected.
    • Genotypes were split with the wrong samples’ ancestry calls, because the ancestry matrix was passed to the C code without transposing it.
    • Variants and regions matched by name are now paired by name; they were paired by position, so a reordered pt_matrix gave wrong results.
    • Coordinate matching ("chr:pos" within "chr:start-end") now allows several variants per region, which previously gave an error.
    • counts are now per variant, as documented (they were per sample).
    • Unnamed matrices of different sizes no longer fail, and inputs with no variant overlap give a clear error.
  • Exported functions now check their arguments and give informative errors.
  • New defaults: split_diploid_multi() defaults to the two-population codes of split_diploid(); read_bed_file() finds the .bim and .fam files next to the .bed file; ancestry_split_phased() needs out_path only when write_vcf = TRUE.
  • ancestry_smmat() now requires ancestry_counts and variant_info together (previously one without the other was silently ignored).
  • The C code checks for user interrupts.
  • Long functions were split into smaller helpers and loops vectorized; results are unchanged.
  • Removed the unused global-ancestry helpers and the internal centromeres_hg38 table.
  • Vignettes rewritten for readability; the real-data vignette’s source is no longer shipped in vignettes/. The Getting started vignette now explains the method’s motivation with figures from the LANTERN preprint.
  • Added citation("lantern") for the preprint (Wang et al. 2026, medRxiv).

lantern 0.99.0

  • Initial Bioconductor submission.
  • ancestry_split() splits a phased VCF into per-ancestry dosages using RFMix local ancestry, in "haplotype" (phased) or "dosage" (unphased) mode, for any number of populations. Dosage mode shrinks ambiguous mixed-ancestry splits toward 1/2, in proportion to the share of the variant’s evidence that is ambiguous. (An earlier development version shrank toward each chromosome arm’s global local ancestry; that target and the use_gla argument were removed.)
  • write_ancestry_gds() / write_dosage_gds() write SeqArray GDS files.
  • ancestry_smmat() runs ancestry-stratified GMMAT SMMAT gene tests and Cauchy-combines the per-ancestry p-values (cauchy_combine()).
  • VCFs are read with bcftools when it is on PATH, otherwise with SeqArray. Choose one explicitly with options(lantern.vcf_reader = ...).
  • Example dataset in inst/extdata (simulated; see inst/scripts/make_toy_data.R).
